coordinate_note: lat/lon are approximate park centres taken from Wikipedia / OpenStreetMap knowledge (WGS84, 3-4 dp). Sizes are approximate and rounded; null where no reliable figure was found.

parks.name: Canbury Gardens
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no PSPO in Kingston); keep out of fenced playground; riverside path shared with cyclists
parks.notes: Thames-side linear park between Kingston Bridge and Teddington Lock; small for a daily run but links to Thames Path. Kingston confirmed in April 2025 it has no PSPOs in place (dog or otherwise).
parks.managed_by: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames

parks.name: Richmond Park
parks.area: North Kingston; St Margarets/East Twickenham; Mortlake/East Sheen & Barnes
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed away from deer; MANDATORY on lead everywhere 1 May-31 July (deer birthing); advised on lead/avoid deer Sept-Nov (rut); on lead around ponds and in skylark zones (Lawn Field, Crown Field, The Bog); on lead in Isabella Plantation; no dogs in Pembroke Lodge Gardens or playgrounds
parks.notes: Chasing deer is an offence. Royal Parks rule of thumb max 4 dogs per person; commercial walkers need licence. Gates: Kingston Gate (North Kingston), Richmond Gate/Petersham (St Margarets side), Sheen Gate/Bog Gate/Roehampton Gate (East Sheen/Barnes).

parks.name: Bushy Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed away from deer; MANDATORY on lead everywhere 1 May-31 July (deer birthing); keep on lead near deer / avoid Sept-Nov (rut); on short lead in skylark zones Mar-Sept (south of Oval Plantation, west of Hampton Wick cricket ground); on lead around rivers and ponds; no dogs in Woodland Gardens
parks.notes: Reached from North Kingston via Kingston Bridge / Hampton Wick (c.1 km). Royal Parks rule of thumb max 4 dogs per person.

parks.name: Home Park (Hampton Court Park)
parks.off_lead: NOT suitable for off-lead: HRP asks that dogs are kept on a lead at all times; stay 50 m from deer and keep to mown paths (deer park)
parks.notes: 750-acre deer park behind Hampton Court Palace, open 07:00-20:00. Dogs chasing deer have killed deer; prosecution threatened. Good on-lead walk only.

parks.name: Marble Hill Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed in most of the park under close supervision; on lead in and around the cafe; fenced children's play area is dog-free
parks.notes: 65-66 acres riverside parkland; English Heritage site (not council). Proposed code of conduct: professional walkers max 4 dogs, £250 licence.

parks.name: Moormead and Bandy Recreation Ground
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (not in Richmond PSPO on-lead schedule); dogs excluded from fenced playground and enclosed sports/tennis areas; max 4 dogs
parks.notes: Local rec with football pitches, tennis, playground, River Crane along west side. Moor Mead Road TW1 1JS.
parks.managed_by: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames

parks.name: Orleans Gardens
parks.off_lead: Small riverside garden; council page says there is a grassy area where dogs are not allowed; playground dog-free; otherwise general Richmond PSPO applies
parks.notes: Too small for a daily run; mainly a riverside link between Marble Hill and Twickenham riverside. Orleans Road TW1 3BJ.
parks.managed_by: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames

parks.name: Wimbledon Common (incl. Putney Heath)
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed ('run free') if in sight and under effective control; on lead around all ponds and on The Plain (mown paths only) during bird nesting season 1 Mar-31 Aug; follow notices; requested max 4 dogs per group
parks.notes: Independent statutory body (Conservators), not Merton council; byelaws apply. Golf course on common land - move off fairways. Over 75 dog bins.

parks.name: Wimbledon Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (Merton has no dog-control PSPO in force as of Nov 2026); keep out of play areas, splash pad, sports facilities and the lake; a Merton PSPO with dog measures is under consultation (closes 2 Nov 2026)
parks.notes: 27 ha public park with large lake, athletics track, tennis, bowling green; adjoining former golf course is AELTC land, not public park.

parks.name: Dundonald Recreation Ground
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no Merton PSPO in force); keep out of playground and sports areas
parks.notes: Small local rec behind Dundonald Primary; mainly for quick walks. Merton proposed PSPO measures not yet in force.

parks.name: Morden Hall Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed across most of the estate if recall is reliable; on lead in the Rose Garden, around buildings (Stableyard, Snuff Mill, cafes, garden centre), the adventure play area and the wetland boardwalk
parks.notes: National Trust 3-pawprint site, 125 acres, River Wandle; six dog bins. c.3 km from Wimbledon town centre.

parks.name: Barnes Common
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under control (may mean leading up when asked); Richmond PSPO: on lead at Barnes Pond, max 4 dogs, dogs excluded from enclosed play/sports areas
parks.notes: Local Nature Reserve (acid grassland, woodland), cricket and football pitch; Vine Road SW13 0NE. Managed by charity Barnes Common Ltd on behalf of the council.
parks.managed_by: Barnes Common Ltd (for LB Richmond upon Thames)

parks.name: Sheen Common / East Sheen Common
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed in the woodland (popular with dog walkers); Richmond PSPO requires lead at Sheen Common Pond; dogs excluded from bowling green, tennis courts and natural playground; max 4 dogs
parks.notes: Woodland adjoining Richmond Park at Bog Gate (links straight into the park). Freehold National Trust, managed by Richmond council. Fife Road SW14 7EL.
parks.managed_by: LB Richmond upon Thames (freehold National Trust)

parks.name: Palewell Common and Fields
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed on the open fields (not in PSPO on-lead schedule); dogs excluded from play areas, paddling pool and enclosed sports areas; keep off pitch-and-putt course; max 4 dogs
parks.notes: Pitch & putt, petanque, cricket, football, cafe. Enmore Gardens SW14 8RF. Connects to Richmond Park via Palewell gate path.
parks.managed_by: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames

parks.name: Barn Elms / WWT London Wetland Centre
parks.off_lead: NOT a dog venue: Richmond PSPO bans dogs from Barn Elms playing fields at all times; WWT London Wetland Centre admits assistance dogs only. Thames towpath alongside is on-lead (highway) under the PSPO
parks.notes: Included so the map does not suggest it as a dog walk. Use Barnes Common or Putney Lower Common instead.
parks.managed_by: LB Richmond upon Thames (playing fields) / WWT (wetland centre)

parks.name: Clapham Common
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed on the open common; dog-free: Eagle Pond, Mount Pond, Bandstand Beds, play areas (Battersea Rise, Windmill Drive), skate park/sports hub, The Spinney, fenced sports facilities; on lead at the four cafe seating areas; proposed Lambeth limit max 4 dogs with max 2 off lead
parks.notes: Lambeth's Dog Control PSPO text is from the 2023 draft; adoption status could not be confirmed online on 2026-11-01. A fenced Westside dog exercise area exists.

parks.name: Wandsworth Common
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed on the open common; on lead near the lake/ponds (dogs must not enter water), north of the tennis courts and around Skylark cafe; excluded from all playgrounds and the cricket field; max 4 dogs (6 with licence); lead by direction of Parks Police
parks.notes: Wandsworth Parks & Open Spaces PSPO in force since Oct 2025 (renewed borough dog controls). Exact on-lead/exclusion boundaries are on council maps (wandsworth_pspo_maps.pdf).

parks.name: Battersea Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed on open grass; dogs excluded from certain areas (children's play areas, sports facilities, lake and water features, formal gardens as mapped); on lead in car parks, cafe seating and by direction; max 4 dogs
parks.notes: Council lists Battersea Park as a park where dogs are excluded from certain areas only (not whole park). Exact zones on the council PSPO map.

parks.name: Hampstead Heath
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed across the open Heath if the dog responds to recall; on lead in formal landscapes (Golders Hill Park), sports pitches and where signed; excluded from playgrounds, fenced conservation areas and ponds (except designated dog-swimming spots); max 4 dogs per person; professionals need licence
parks.notes: City of London byelaws 21-23 apply. Not Camden council land. Around 1.5-2 km from West Hampstead.

parks.name: Fortune Green
parks.off_lead: Small green; Camden PSPO lists Fortune Green among long-standing dog-free areas (press report says the picnic area); adjacent Hampstead Cemetery is on-lead only
parks.notes: Not a daily off-lead option; Camden general rule elsewhere: off lead in parks except gated playgrounds/sports areas, on lead on streets.

parks.name: Kilburn Grange Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under Camden's general rule (parks and green spaces) except gated playgrounds and gated sports areas; on lead if asked by an officer
parks.notes: Small neighbourhood park with large playground and sports facilities; not named in Camden's exclusion list.

parks.name: Epsom Common Local Nature Reserve
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under close control; council advises lead near sheep and recall/unclip if cattle approach (seasonal cattle grazing in fenced compartments); keep out of ponds; advised max 6 dogs
parks.notes: SSSI/LNR adjoining Ashtead Common (City of London). Stew Ponds car park off Christ Church Road. No borough dog PSPO found.

parks.name: Epsom Downs
parks.off_lead: On lead until 12 noon while racehorses train (Conservators' request); free to run off lead after noon; keep under control near horses; racecourse closed on race days
parks.notes: Epsom & Walton Downs c.600 acres of chalk downland managed by the Conservators (council + Jockey Club). Commercial dog walking licensing considered 2024.

parks.name: Horton Country Park Local Nature Reserve
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under close control; keep out of winter woodland-works areas; fouling an offence
parks.notes: 400 acres of woodland and grassland, car park off Horton Lane. Also hosts Hobbledown farm (separate, no dogs).

parks.name: Nonsuch Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed in open parkland (code says 'safe, designated areas'); on lead near Nonsuch Pantry cafe and front of Mansion; dogs excluded from the Formal Garden and the picnic areas at Cheam, Sparrow Farm Road and London Road gates; private walkers advised max 4, licensed commercial max 6
parks.notes: 300 acres on the Epsom & Ewell / Sutton border; commercial dog-walking licence scheme adopted 2024-25.
parks.managed_by: Nonsuch Park Joint Management Committee (Epsom & Ewell BC and LB Sutton)

parks.name: Alexandra Recreation Ground
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no borough dog PSPO found); keep out of playground, skate park and sports pitches; fouling £80 FPN
parks.notes: Town rec off Alexandra Road KT17; rules inferred from council general dog guidance, no park-specific page found.

parks.name: Rosebery Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under control (no borough dog PSPO found); keep out of playground and away from the pond
parks.notes: Small formal town park near Epsom station; rules inferred from council general guidance, no park-specific page found.

parks.name: Verulamium Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (St Albans has no dog PSPOs); keep out of playgrounds and the lake; cattle graze Seabrook Meadow seasonally; 10+ dog bins
parks.notes: 66.9 ha incl. lake and Roman remains. Council says it has no PSPOs applying to dogs; a street-drinking PSPO covers the park.
parks.managed_by: St Albans City & District Council (John O'Conner contractor)

parks.name: Clarence Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no dog PSPO in district); keep out of playground, cricket ground and sports facilities
parks.notes: Victorian park by St Albans City station; no park-specific dog page found.

parks.name: Heartwood Forest
parks.off_lead: Dogs welcome; Woodland Trust standard guidance: off lead if under control, on lead near livestock and in bird-nesting season where signed, pick up
parks.notes: 346.7 ha new native forest north of Sandridge (grid TL162114), c.4-5 km from St Albans centre.

parks.name: Bernards Heath
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no dog PSPO in district); keep out of playground and playing pitches
parks.notes: Open heath/recreation ground north of the city centre; no park-specific dog page found.

parks.name: Highfield Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed under control (charity park, no PSPO); keep out of playgrounds and orchard events areas
parks.notes: c.60-acre rural park on former hospital land, run by Highfield Park Trust since 1996; trust site has no dog page.

parks.name: Jersey Farm Woodland Park
parks.off_lead: Off lead allowed (no dog PSPO in district); under control near grazing/wildflower meadows
parks.notes: Community woodland/meadow between Jersey Farm estate and Sandridge; no park-specific dog page found.

council_rules.council: The Royal Parks (Richmond Park, Bushy Park)
council_rules.rule: Dogs on lead compulsory in all areas 1 May-31 July (deer birthing). Sept-Nov rut: keep on lead near deer / 50-100 m away or walk elsewhere (advisory). On lead around ponds and in skylark zones; no dogs in playgrounds, cafes, Pembroke Lodge Gardens, Woodland Gardens. Rule of thumb max 4 dogs per person; commercial walkers licensed. Chasing deer is an offence.

council_rules.council: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames
council_rules.rule: Dog Control PSPO (in force since 16 Oct 2017, extended 2020, 2023 and from 21 Sept 2026 for 3 years): pick up everywhere; max 4 dogs per person (licence for more); dogs on lead on all highways incl. pavements, towpaths and verges, in cemeteries and at listed sites (Crane Park Island, Leg o'Mutton, Terrace Gardens, York House Gardens, Kings Field, Diamond Jubilee Gardens, ponds at Ham Common, Kew, Barnes and Sheen Common); dogs excluded from enclosed play/sports areas, Barn Elms playing fields (always) and Petersham Meadows (1 Apr-31 Oct); 'proper control' required.

council_rules.council: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames
council_rules.rule: No PSPOs in place (council answer 1 April 2025): no dog-control PSPO, no max-dogs limit, no on-lead-on-roads rule. Fouling enforced under general law; playgrounds dog-free by byelaw/signage.

Parks and Open Spaces PSPO (dog control) in force since Oct 2025: max 4 dogs (licensed walkers excepted in certain parks); dogs on lead on all public highways incl. pavements, verges, tree bases; on lead in car parks, cafe seating, cemeteries, Town Hall gardens and certain small parks; excluded from children's playgrounds, sports facilities, lakes/ponds/water features and leisure-centre surrounds; on lead when directed by Parks Police. 16 small sites are entirely dog-free (e.g. Upper Tooting Park, Swaby Gardens).

Dog Control PSPO (drafted 2023, consultation closed 26 Mar 2023; adoption not confirmed online on 2026-11-01): pick up; lead by direction; max 4 dogs with max 2 off lead; excluded from play areas, sports courts/pitches, community gardens and listed Clapham Common sites (Eagle Pond, Mount Pond, Bandstand Beds, The Spinney, skate park); on lead at cafe seating areas, churchyards, nature reserves and all housing land.
No dog-control PSPO in force (council page, Nov 2026). Dog measures are proposed within a wider anti-social behaviour PSPO; consultation closes 2 Nov 2026. Fouling enforced under national law.
Byelaws: dogs in sight and under effective control; on lead around all ponds and on The Plain 1 Mar-31 Aug; obey notices; no more than 4 dogs per group requested; pick up (75+ bins).

Dog Control PSPO (first made 2017, renewed): pick up (£100 FPN); dogs on lead on roads, pavements, car parks, estate roads/communal areas and Hampstead Cemetery; on lead when an officer asks; off lead allowed in parks and green spaces except gated playgrounds and gated sports areas; dogs excluded from Local Nature Reserves (Adelaide, Westbere Copse, Belsize Wood, Carnley Street) and long-standing dog-free areas incl. Camden Square (north), Primrose Gardens (north) and Fortune Green (picnic area).

Byelaws 21-23: proper control; no dogs in ponds or areas where notices prohibit; excluded from playgrounds and fenced conservation areas; on lead in formal areas (Golders Hill Park) and sports pitches; max 4 dogs per person; professional walkers need licence (£211-£355/yr).

No borough-wide dog PSPO found. Council guidance: keep on lead if recall unreliable; short lead near sheep, release if cattle approach; keep out of ponds; advises no more than 6 dogs; fouling £80 FPN (up to £1,000 on prosecution). Nonsuch Park has a commercial dog-walking licence scheme and code (max 6 for licensed walkers). Epsom Downs: on lead until noon for racehorse training.

Council states it currently has no PSPOs applying to dogs. Fouling reported to the council (01727 819598); put dog on lead if told by police/council officer. Only PSPO in the city is a street-drinking order (incl. Verulamium Park).

gaps: Kingston and St Albans council websites refused automated fetches; their positions (no dog PSPOs) come from a council Q&A PDF (Kingston, Apr 2025) and the St Albans 'pests and animal welfare' page respectively.
Lambeth Dog Control PSPO: only the 2023 draft is online; could not confirm whether it was made/renewed. Clapham Common exclusion zones are from that draft.
Wandsworth and Battersea Park exact on-lead/exclusion boundaries are only on council map PDFs (not parsed).

No park-specific dog pages found for Clarence Park, Bernards Heath, Jersey Farm Woodland Park, Alexandra Rec, Rosebery Park, Dundonald Rec, Kilburn Grange Park; entries rely on each council's general rule.

Coordinates are approximate centres from Wikipedia/OSM knowledge (Nominatim blocked); sizes are rounded and some (Moormead, Orleans Gardens, Palewell, Jersey Farm, Highfield, Bernards Heath, Alexandra, Rosebery) are estimates.
Richmond PSPO 2026 renewal text was read from the consultation draft; the sealed 2026 order was not located.
